title: How to test MCP Apps for accessibility, and why it matters
partialText:
MCP Apps are still new enough that whatever approaches we can establish now will be the ones that stick over the long term. Which means if we can get accessibility right at this stage, it will stay right as the ecosystem grows. This is how we can avoid introducing the same problems we've had to deal with across the rest of the web for so long.

The post How to test MCP Apps for accessibility, and why it matters appeared first on Deque.

title: EN 301 549 v4.1.1 is final! What changed, what it means, and what you should do.
partialText:
On September 2, 2026, EN 301 549 v4.1.1 was officially published. This represents a major update to Europe’s accessibility standard for ICT products and services, and it’s a big milestone. But in practice, it’s only the first step along a three-point timeline.
